description: Microbiology request: quantitative antigen/antibody tests = serology (MII KDS Mikrobiologie 2027, profile MII_PR_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitativ, ValueSet MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitative_Tests_LOINC = LOINC SCALE Qn + immunoassay METHOD_TYPs in CLASS MICRO). Ontology groupers: antibodies to pathogens are << 312301006 |Infective organism antibody| (IgG/IgM/IgA to a named organism), antigens are << 116633006 |Microbial antigen|. Quantitative properties: arbitrary concentration (U/mL, index), mass concentration, substance concentration, number concentration. Most quantitative serology observables carry NO technique.

queries.name: Serology quantitative — concentration of a pathogen antibody or antigen
queries.description: Quantitative antibody/antigen observables, any technique or none.
queries.ecl: << 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118569000 |Arbitrary concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR 118539007 |Mass concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR 118556004 |Substance concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR 118550005 |Number concentration (property) (qualifier value)|), 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = (<< 312301006 |Infective organism antibody (substance)| OR << 116633006 |Microbial antigen (substance)|)
